title: Host Accounts Fee Schedule: Host Service Fee by Host Tier
content:
# Host Accounts Fee Schedule — Host Service Fee

Roamhaven's service fee on a stay is split between guest and host in one of two fee structures, and the host's share is withheld from the host's earnings as the host service fee. The structure and the percentages below are fixed by the host tier of the Host Accounts holder.

- **Split fee**: the service fee is shared between the guest and the host.
- **Host-only fee**: the whole service fee is carried by the host.

## Schedule by host tier

| Host tier | Fee structure on stays booked while the account holds the tier | Host service fee on stays of the tier's own structure | Percentage on a split-fee stay while the tier carries a host-only fee | Percentage on a host-only-fee stay while the tier carries a split fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter Host | Split fee | 3.00% | 3.00% | 15.50% |
| Standard Host | Split fee | 3.00% | 3.00% | 15.50% |
| Superhost | Split fee | 3.00% | 3.00% | 15.50% |
| Professional Host | Host-only fee | 15.50% | 3.00% | 15.50% |
| Professional Host Plus | Host-only fee | 15.00% | 3.00% | 15.50% |
| Enterprise Partner | Host-only fee | 14.00% | 3.00% | 15.50% |

## Terms common to every tier

| Item | Term (identical for all six tiers) |
|---|---|
| Host-fee base | The stay's nightly subtotal, cleaning fee, pet fee total and extra-guest fee total |
| When the fee is assessed | At check-in, on the stay's amounts as booked or as last altered |
| Refund of the fee | Proportional to the host-funded amount refunded to the guest after the payout release |

## Notes to the schedule

1. The fee structure is a property of the stay as well as of the tier: a stay keeps the structure it was booked under. The two right-hand columns therefore apply only where the stay's structure differs from the structure the account's current tier carries.
2. The percentages are percentages of the host-fee base. Occupancy tax and the guest service fee are not part of the base.

## Reading the schedule (hypothetical illustrations)

- A Superhost stay booked under the split fee, with a hypothetical host-fee base of USD 800.00, sits in the tier's own structure; the schedule's percentage for it is 3.00%.
- A Professional Host account whose stay was booked under the split fee before the account became professional is a split-fee stay assessed while the tier carries a host-only fee; the schedule's percentage for it is 3.00%.
- A Standard Host account with a stay booked under the host-only fee is a host-only-fee stay assessed while the tier carries a split fee; the schedule's percentage for it is 15.50%.
